card.text: A nearby K star orbited by six sub-Neptunes in a resonant chain.

introduction.text: HD 110067 has six transiting sub-Neptunes with linked orbital periods. Their years range from 9.11 to 54.77 days.

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: Colour from its measured spectrum, with a modeled darker edge. No surface map or absolute brightness.
